description: Hyperscaler AI Deal Tracker — live feed of Stargate, OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, Oracle, CoreWeave, AMD, NVIDIA, sovereign-AI deals. Pulls from dchub news pipeline, extracts $-figures + MW via regex, classifies by actor. 10-min refresh. Use for tracking AI capex events ($1B+/week typical), capacity announcements, and competitive intel. Do NOT use for the full historical M&A comp set (use list_transactions) or a single-deal teardown with grid context (use deal_autopsy); this is the live $1B+ AI-capex feed. limit 1-500. Hyperscaler leases and purchases only; for all M&A use list_transactions.
